about: Photo look (house style for story and philosophy cards).

image.prompt: Ancient Chinese bamboo scrolls tied with cord on a dark lacquered table, a single candle, ink brush beside them.

scenes.narration: The best victory is the one that needs no fight.

image.prompt: A vast ancient army camp on a misty plain at dawn, banners and tents stretching to the horizon, painterly cinematic.
A lone ancient general's helmet resting on a stone wall overlooking a misty valley.

scenes.narration: Sun Tzu, the ancient Chinese general, said that winning every battle is not the highest skill.

image.prompt: An empty battlefield after a fight, broken spears and smoke drifting over muddy ground at dusk.
A dark figure watching from a distant ridge at night, silhouette against a red sky.

scenes.narration: Even a battle you win costs you time, money, and goodwill. And it leaves an enemy waiting for revenge.

image.prompt: Two business people shaking hands across a modern glass meeting table, city skyline at sunset, faces out of focus.
A crumpled contract on a polished boardroom table, cold light, no readable text.

scenes.narration: The same is true at work. A deal that humiliates the other side is a deal they will quietly undermine.

image.prompt: Two hands placing chess pieces back in the box together, warm light, calm friendly mood.
Two people walking together along a bridge at golden hour, seen from behind.

scenes.narration: So look for an outcome they can accept. A smart offer, a better option, a shared interest. Win, and keep the relationship.

image.prompt: A calm lake at sunrise with mist on the water, a single small boat, peaceful.

scenes.narration: Pick one disagreement you're in. What could you offer that gives them what they want, while you still get what you need?
